acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command lists OPEN tickets cited by merged commits/PR merge bodies on the integration ref, with the citing commit and the blocking closeout step.
Partial delivery is not inferred as complete: the report never completes a ticket and labels findings as candidates.
A fixture covers: cited+gate-failed, cited+no attempt, umbrella PR citing several tickets, and an uncited ticket (not listed).
body: Observed 2026-10-17: a read-only audit of 37 of 76 suspected delivered-but-open tickets confirmed 22 delivered on origin/main (e.g. V1-0252..0255 via #202/#205/#206/#904, V1-0414, V1-0811), 13 partial, 2 not delivered. Causes seen: completion is a separate post-merge native write that no merge triggers; closeout waiters die on CIFAIL/session end and merge events are not delivered (auto-merge completion did not wake the session); `complete` is refused when a required gate (full-gate) failed under host load (V1-0414 GATE_FAILED) and the ticket stays open by design; work landed under umbrella/closeout PRs or GitHub issue numbers, not the ticket ID; builders and reviewers may not run corvint-tasks, so the orchestrator is the only closer. A 2026-10-14 audit found the same class (memory batch-similar-tickets). Expected: the store reports, without mutating, OPEN tickets whose ID or linked issue appears in a merged commit/PR on the integration branch, with the pending closeout step (gate failed, no attempt, not submitted), so closeout debt is visible instead of discovered by audits.
title: corvint-tasks: detect delivered-but-open tickets (merged PRs/commits citing an OPEN ticket) and queue their closeout
